answer: Because the timing is recorded against the atlas challenge, the copper audit can replay the meadow history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 135 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 25 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
